snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027? Samarjeet Singh (HCS Rank 59, HCS 2026) shares his advice on completing your optional subject by January and planning your Prelims preparation effectively.

A LevelUp IAS student and UPSC CSE 2026 Interview candidate, he also shares his experience with the Prelims Master Program (PMP) and explains how structured classes, tests and multiple rounds of syllabus revision can help aspirants prepare for Prelims.

Explore PMP 2027: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-prelims-master-program-pmp/

#UPSC2027 #UPSCPrelims2027 #PMP2027 #PrelimsMasterProgram #LevelUpIAS
